Or_15000_0018

Or.15000/0018 (= M.Tagh.0494)
    photo
1. Content : document, letter type 3
2. Note : fragment. Recto, 10 lines. Verso, 2 lines. Addressed to jo-bo Rgyal-bzang. The sender's name is mostly missing due to paper damage. Since the left edge is torn off, a few characters are missing at the beginning of each line. Another leter to Rgyal-bzang, by the same hand, starts in the middle of r7 and ends in r10. Though the bottom edge is torn off, r10 is most probably the las of the letter. Verso is probably a letter draft written by the same hand as recto, but too faint to read except for the syllable 'drul. Two lines of small holes appear near the right, bottom, and left edges (cf. Or.15000/36).
3. References :
Takeuchi (1997-98, vol.1: pl.72).
Takeuchi (1997-98, vol.2: no.72)[I.Translit.].
